reviews.author: Anthony Fain
reviews.text: Delicious food and great service — always a nice experience whether we go for lunch or dinner. Never had to ask for a refill or a box because they were already on it. Highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: Jada Green
reviews.text: Today was my first time eating here and it was 10/10 — everything was so good. Service was great, the food was hot and fresh. I don't know why I hadn't eaten here sooner. Can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Becky Ryan
reviews.text: Have enjoyed this place for a long time! Good food, good people — can't beat it!

reviews.author: Mark Jones
reviews.text: Had breakfast here recently with our old guys retired group. Our servers were fantastic! Extremely nice ladies that took great care of us. Didn't let our coffee get empty. My omelet was delicious. Looking forward to coming back for breakfast again soon.

reviews.author: John Hoyt
reviews.text: First time in... I explained to them I had never been there before and they treated me like a long lost friend. The wait staff were very attentive, the food was piping hot, and this place is huge! There's a buffet if you're into that — I ordered the burger special plate and it was very good. I'll be back...

reviews.author: Nathan Byrum
reviews.text: I drove over 37 minutes just to try this place and man, was it so worth it. I highly recommend it. The BBQ ribs, mac and cheese, fries, and sweet tea are so worth it. 10/10

reviews.author: Devon Wilson
reviews.text: Very good and inexpensive food with great prices. I enjoy being a local here.

reviews.author: Andrea Lollis
reviews.text: Everyone is great, food great, clean as a whistle and very helpful. Food is awesome!!
